heading: Without `dynamic_ttl` and `realtime`
text:
### Without `dynamic_ttl` and `realtime` [LDTL.2.3]

When `realtime` is active but `dynamic_ttl` is not, the engine must reserve
everything the per-schema FIFO TTL queues ([LDTL.3.1]) need during INIT, before
the transition to LIVE, and the TTL path must allocate nothing during LIVE
([RTCT.12.4]). The queues hold at most N_max facts together, because each fact
belongs to exactly one schema's queue.
